errors.text_span: Оста X представлява кумулативния процент на работещите
errors.evidence: The X-axis label is 'Работодатели - кумулативна относителна честота (%)', which translates to 'Employers - cumulative relative frequency (%)'. The description incorrectly states that it represents 'работещите' (employees/workers).
The list of tick marks for the X-axis omits the 90% label, which is present on the axis.

errors.text_span: Оста Y показва кумулативния процент на работодателите
errors.evidence: The Y-axis label is 'Запазени работни места - кумулативна относителна честота (%)', which translates to 'Retained jobs - cumulative relative frequency (%)'. The description incorrectly states it represents 'работодателите' (employers), effectively swapping the meaning of the two axes.
This is the second occurrence of this text string. The list of tick marks for the Y-axis omits the 90% label, which is present on the axis.
